name: Ayurvedic Treatment of Tonsillitis

sections.herbal_remedies:
About Tonsillitis 
 There are two masses of tissues at the back of the throat that act as filters. The main function of these filters is to trap the germs that enters the airways and can cause infection. The other function is to produce antibodies that fight with the infection. Sometimes due to bacteria or viruses, tonsils become infected and they get inflamed and swollen which results into tonsillitis. 
 Main Reasons for Tonsillitis 

 Adenoviruses 
 Influenza viruses 
 Enteroviruses 
 Herpes simplex virus 
 Para-inflluenza viruses 

 These are some of the causes of tonsillitis. These virus or bacteria can cause tonsillitis and can lead to swelling and inflammation.
sections.symptoms_of_tonsillitis:
Swelling of tonsils 

 Inflammation 
 Throat pain 
 Tenderness 
 Swollen glands 
 Fever chills 
 Nausea 
 Bad breath 
 Swollen glands in the neck or jaw area 
 Painful blisters or ulcers on the throat 
 White or yellow coating on tonsils
